title: LXD has CreateCustomVolumeFromBackup nil-pointer dereference on volumes[0].snapshots[*].expires_at (CVE-2026-9639)
description: CVE-2026-9639 is a vulnerability in the LXD daemon's CreateCustomVolumeFromBackup function where an unguarded dereference of a nil pointer occurs on the ExpiresAt field of volume snapshots in a custom volume backup. An authenticated user with permission to create storage volumes can crash the LXD daemon by uploading a crafted backup tarball missing the expires_at field in snapshots. This causes a panic in the Go runtime, resulting in a denial of service. The issue is fixed in commit 0.0.0-20260622081844-85f897013ccd.
